newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium should drop support for Mobutu, Kabila says.
newsitem.headline: Belgium should drop support for Mobutu, Kabila says.

text.p: Belgium, Zaire's former colonial ruler, should drop support for Zairean president Mobutu Sese Seko, Zairean rebel leader Laurent Kabila said on Wednesday.
"Belgium should drop support for that despicable Mobutu," Kabila told VTM televison. "How can Belgium justify support for Mobutu."
Kabila's forces have taken a large swath of eastern Zaire and are now standing at the edge of Kisangani, Zaire's third-largest city and gateway to the Zaire river.
Their aim is to overthrow the ailing Mobutu, who has reigned the vast and dirt-poor central African country since 1965.
Belgian relations with Mobutu's regime have been icy in recent years, although there has been no break of diplomatic ties.
Belgium does not have diplomatic relations with Kabila's movement, a Belgian foreign ministry spokesman said earlier.
